sermon.title: The Word, What is a Christian - September 22, 2024
sermon.speaker: Michael Silla
sermon.summary: Scripture makes us complete. The Sadducees erred, not knowing the Scriptures or the power of God. Those who encounter Christ get their questions answered, like Nicodemus learning to be born again. By His blood we can boldly enter the Holy of Holies—make time for the word.
